confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Sanya and Hainan tourist pricing; no live listings or web sources were used for the price anchors. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by season, location (Dadonghai, Yalong Bay, city centre) and booking channel. July is peak summer season in Sanya, so hotel anchors are set toward the upper-middle of the plausible range. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local price relationship to beer, since direct knowledge of bar pricing is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on coastal Chinese resort cities and Hainan tourism pricing, with prices set somewhat above inland Chinese cities of similar size to reflect resort-area demand in summer.
